Section 4: Solid Waste Management and Garbage Accumulation (SOP-SWM-03) Responsible Department: Sanitation Department. uncollected municipal solid waste, community bin overflow, unauthorized street dumping, and organic waste decay. Procedures: (1) Sanitation inspector site visit within 12 hours. Redressal Window: Community bins cleared within 12 to 24 hours; bulk dump site cleared in 48 hours. Section 5: Streetlight Failure and Public Lighting Infrastructure (SOP-SL-04)

Responsible Department: Electrical Maintenance Department. Scope covers non-functioning streetlights, damaged lamp posts, flickering LED fixtures, day-burning lights, and exposed feeder wires. Procedures: (1) Locate unique alphanumeric pole identifier. (2) Dispatch maintenance lineman team. (3) Replace LED driver, bulb, or repaired underground cable. Redressal Window: Single lamp failure rectified in 48 hours; cable break or dark zone rectified within 72 hours. Scope encompasses potable pipeline bursts, main valve leakage, broken public taps, and contamination seepage into distribution mains. Procedures: (1) Immediate reporting to 24/7 Water Control Room.
